But any way, I want to say this about Maria Muldar. The one thing that impressed me, the first time I heard her sing -- as a matter of fact we did an album with her. This -- so we did this tour as a result of the album. But the one thing that impressed me about Maria Muldar, she sounded like Mildred Bailey. And I asked her had she ever heard Mildred at this time and she said, no, but several people had told her this. But she sounded like, just like Mildred Bailey, a young Mildred Bailey.
